message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates, 35 mph on rural highways, 25 mph on urban highways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 15 mph if a school bus is stopped).
• Construction zones: 30 mph unless posted otherwise. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑safety seat or booster.
• Back‑seat seats are mandatory for children under 13. | Texas Transportation Code §545.002 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.003 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for drivers 21+.
• Lower limits for commercial drivers (0.04 %) and drivers under 21 (0.02 %).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.004 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians in crosswalks.
• Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• “Yield” signs give priority to the vehicle already in the intersection. | Texas Transportation Code §545.005 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during rain, fog, or low visibility.
• Fog lights only when visibility is ≤ 200 ft. | Texas Transportation Code §545.006 | | **Towing & Hitching** | • Towing vehicles must have a tow bar or hitch rated for the load.
• Properly secured loads are required; unsecured loads can be fined. | Texas Transportation Code §545.007 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Annual registration renewal required.
• Vehicle inspections are required for certain vehicles (e.g., commercial, older cars). | Texas Transportation Code §545.008 | | **Parking Rules** | • No parking in fire lanes, handicap spaces (unless you have a permit), or on sidewalks.
• Parking on the curb is allowed only if the curb is not marked for no parking. | Texas Transportation Code §545.009 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Drivers must not pass a stopped school bus until the bus’s stop sign is lowered. | Texas Transportation Code §545.010 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals at least 100 ft before changing lanes.
• Overtaking is prohibited on the right side of a lane unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | Texas Transportation Code §545.011 | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens. | Texas Transportation Code §545.012 | | **Penalties & Enforcement** | • Fines vary by offense; repeat offenders face higher penalties.
• Points added to driver’s record can lead to license suspension. | Texas Transportation Code §545.013 | --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website: [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) 2. **Texas Transportation Code** – Accessible via the Texas Legislature’s website or legal databases. 3. **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances or recent changes. --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always keep your headlights on** during low‑visibility conditions. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk on your phone. - **Check your vehicle’s registration** before traveling long distances. - **Observe speed limits**—they’re strictly enforced, especially in school zones. - **Be mindful of construction zones**—speed limits often drop to 30 mph. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular driving scenario!
